Ending Soon07:00:09
PondPhuwin
Video Call with GrabTH
Oct 12 ~ Oct 14, 2026
17:00 ~ 19:00 ICT
Event Details
How to participate

Purchase any qualifying merch or one complete photocard set during the event period.

(Ex: Purchase 1 complete set of Est Be My Valentine photocards to receive 1 entry coupon.)

After receiving your coupon, submit it through the event page to enter the draw.

Winners will be selected through a random draw. If you are selected as a winner, you will receive a notification in your Inbox.

Winner Announcement

30 winners will be selected and notified on Oct 16, 2026 via Inbox notification.

If the participant is not the selected winner or if two or more people participate in the call, the event cannot proceed.

Video Call Guidelines

Each winner will be given approximately 2 minutes for the video call.

Audio recording, video recording, and live streaming on social media are strictly prohibited during the video call.

Bonus Gifts

Each winner will randomly receive one of the following:
• One voice message
• One digital sign with a personalized message of encouragement

Bonus gifts will be delivered within 7 days after the event.
